free_tier.stated: Search and Fetch are free at any wallet balance, within 30 requests a minute and 500 an hour for Search and 150 URLs a minute and 1,000 a day for Fetch; an $8 wallet grant covers Agent and Browser

limits.value: Search is capped at 30 requests a minute and 500 an hour on the free path
Fetch is capped at 150 URLs a minute and 1,000 a day on the free path
an $8 wallet grant is one-time; Agent and Browser need funds to start, and a run under way finishes at a zero balance

confidence_note: the pricing page was read on 2026-10-22 and states which meters are free at a zero balance and which draw from the wallet. The distinction is the whole finding: two of four products are free indefinitely

evidence.proved: 'Search and Fetch free at any Wallet balance' with 'Search at 30 requests / min and 500 requests / hour, Fetch at 150 urls / min and 1,000 urls / day. No charge, no Wallet draw, and they keep working at a $0 balance.' and 'New accounts start with $8 in Wallet funds', quoted

session_cap.note: Search and Fetch answer a request; Agent runs are capped at 2 concurrent and Browser sessions at 5

net.allowance: no subscription and no monthly minimum
